review_notes: I read the whole 11-line file and the definitions of rsBeta, rsGamma, kleinH and kleinT in Definitions/Def_EllipticCurve_RubinSilverbergFamily.lean. The file has one theorem. It has no simp attributes, no simp set and no rewrite rules that could compete, loop or expand unwantedly. The proof unfolds the definitions, then uses field_simp and ring. That is a reasonable one-off use for an identity with a specific closed form. I found no evidence that a simp lemma or an orientation change would help any use. The identity is also not a generally useful simp lemma, because its right-hand side expands to a larger expression. I did not run Lean, and I did not search for downstream users beyond the definitions file.
